ns2:section.sectionText: So, You Think You Want to Be a Teacher?, 1 hour. This course is intended for freshmen who are considering a career in teaching, pre-K-12. Through readings, guest presentations and panels, videotapes, and discussions, students will explore the challenges and rewards of teaching, and learn what is involved. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
